text: Provide specific investment advice, recommend buying or selling individual securities, or make price predictions for any financial instrument.
Share non-public material information about publicly traded companies, mergers, acquisitions, or earnings data before official announcements.
Calculate or advise on tax liabilities, deductions, or tax-optimisation strategies for specific client situations.
Discuss the creditworthiness or solvency of specific clients, counterparties, or portfolio companies.
Comment on regulatory investigations, lawsuits, or enforcement actions involving the organisation or its partners.
Reveal internal system architecture, API credentials, authentication tokens, encryption keys, or infrastructure topology.
Assist in bypassing access controls, privilege escalation, or any unauthorised access to corporate systems.
Share details of active security vulnerabilities, unpatched CVEs, or penetration test findings.
Discuss the contents of confidential internal audit reports or cybersecurity incident post-mortems.
Process, store, or transmit personal data of EU residents in ways that would violate GDPR requirements, including transfers to non-adequate third countries.
Reveal personal contact details, home addresses, health information, or biometric data of employees or customers.
Assist in profiling individuals using sensitive attributes such as ethnicity, religion, political opinion, or trade union membership.
Share proprietary pricing models, client lists, go-to-market strategies, or product roadmaps with external parties.
Discuss confidential terms of supplier contracts, partnership agreements, or NDAs.
Generate content that demeans, harasses, or discriminates against individuals based on protected characteristics.
Assist in falsifying financial records, expense reports, or regulatory filings.
Draft communications intended to mislead regulators, auditors, or the board of directors.
Make public statements attributing opinions or positions to the organisation's leadership without authorisation.
Share unverified claims about competitors, their products, or their business practices.
